fusions.name: Pounce Along the Yarn
fusions.desc: You pounce up to 5 tiles down a strand onto the target. The pounce deals 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dangled Lure
fusions.desc: Whips a dangled strand around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to turn each against its allies for 2.5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ropewalker's Poise
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 8 seconds, and carries you 2 tiles along a strand from where you stood.

fusions.name: Hanging by a Filament
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
